classes.name: TurnRoundOperator
classes.definition: A joint role, referred to throughout the document as AO/GH, that manages the aircraft turn-round and provides TOBT-related updates to the Airport CDM process.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operator or handler organisation.

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: AO/GH provides or inserts a TOBT value, as referenced across milestones 4-9.

operations.name: updateTOBT
operations.description: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined or estimated turn-round period for the departing flight (milestones 6, 7, 8).

operations.name: confirmFinalTOBT
operations.description: The time at which the AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, at t minutes before EOBT (milestone 9).

operations.name: manageTurnRoundProcess
operations.description: The AO/GH, in coordination with the aircrew, manages the turn-round process accordingly once TOBT/TSAT is stable (milestones 9, 10).

operations.name: recordActualCommenceGroundHandling
operations.description: AO/GH provides the Actual Commence of Ground Handling time (ACGT) (milestone 8).

operations.name: recordAircraftReady
operations.description: AO/GH provides the Actual Ready Time (ARDT) when doors are closed and the aircraft is ready to taxi (milestone 12).

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline that submits the ATC Flight Plan and integrates its own strategy to compute the TOBT for a flight.

operations.name: submitATCFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator (milestone 1).

operations.name: integrateOwnStrategyForTOBT
operations.description: Emphasis is put on the need for the Aircraft Operator to integrate his own strategy to compute a TOBT related to the flight (milestone 9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling organisation that carries out turn-round operations for a flight, jointly referred to with the Aircraft Operator as AO/GH.

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The air traffic control organisation, including ACC, Approach Control Unit and Tower units, that issues TSAT, approves start-up, and sequences departing flights.

attributes.name: unitType
attributes.description: The ATC unit involved, e.g. ACC, Approach Control Unit, or Tower, as named in the document for radar detection and sequencing.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time, t minutes before EOBT, a locally agreed parameter (milestone 10).

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: ATC provides the Actual start up Approval Time (ASAT), the time an aircraft receives its start up approval (milestone 14).

operations.name: confirmTSATToPilot
operations.description: ATC confirms TSAT to the pilot in order to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence (milestone 13).

operations.name: refinePreDepartureSequence
operations.description: ATC refines the pre-departure sequence once the pilot requests start up just before TSAT (milestone 12).

operations.name: resequenceFlight
operations.description: If start-up approval is not granted at TSAT+tolerance, all partners are informed and the flight will be re-sequenced (milestone 14).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT for regulated flights, monitors flight progress, and receives DPI messages from the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: The CTOT is issued by Network Operations and sent to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome, at EOBT-2h if the flight is regulated (milestone 2).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system/organisation that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is distributed by the IFPS so that all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes, receive it (milestone 1).

classes.name: Pilot
classes.definition: The aircrew member who requests start-up approval from ATC ahead of TSAT.

operations.name: requestStartUp
operations.description: The pilot requests start up just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler (milestone 12), triggering ATC's start-up request handling (milestone 13).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single arrival or departure operation of an aircraft, tracked through the sixteen milestones of the Airport CDM process.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration associated with the flight, fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI (milestone 1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update (milestone 1).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether this leg is the arrival or departure flight of a turn-round (milestone 1).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, changed by each milestone as it occurs.

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight has received a CTOT and is therefore regulated; regulated fields are marked REGULATED (milestone 2).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: An aircraft turn-round normally comprising a related arriving and departing flight pair.

attributes.name: turnRoundId
attributes.description: Identifier of the turn-round grouping an arrival and a departure flight.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft that operates a flight, identified by registration and type.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, as may be updated from the flight plan (milestone 1).

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC Flight Plan submitted for a flight, possibly a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

attributes.name: repetitive
attributes.description: Whether this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

attributes.name: submissionTime
attributes.description: Time the ATC Flight Plan was submitted, normally 3 hours before EOBT though it may be later (milestone 1).

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: The departure aerodrome named in the flight plan (milestone 1).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome named in the flight plan (milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to a flight under the airport slot programme, against which the ATC Flight Plan must be consistent.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The scheduled time associated with the airport slot.

attributes.name: aerodrome
attributes.description: The aerodrome to which the slot applies.

classes.name: Airport
classes.definition: An aerodrome involved in a flight, either as departure (including as an outstation) or destination, which may or may not be schedule-coordinated.

attributes.name: icaoCode
attributes.description: ICAO identifier of the aerodrome.

attributes.name: coordinated
attributes.description: Whether the airport is schedule-coordinated; for coordinated airports the outbound flight is already known, for non-coordinated airports the flight plan is used to initiate the outbound flight (milestone 1).

operations.name: provideActualTakeOffTime
operations.description: The outstation (ADEP) provides ATOT to the Network Operations and Aircraft Operator (milestone 3).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A time value describing a flight's progress, named by a prefix (Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, Calculated) and an event, keeping every successive value with its originator and time of update.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: The prefix identifying the nature of the value: Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, or Calculated.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value itself.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who or what provided or updated this value, e.g. AO, GH, ATC, Network Operations, ACARS, radar.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of the value where the document gives one, e.g. +/- 1 minute.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: The time this value was recorded; updates append a new value rather than overwrite so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The off-block time quantity of a flight, covering SOBT, EOBT, TOBT and AOBT values distinguished by prefix.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The in-block time quantity of a flight, covering EIBT and AIBT values distinguished by prefix.

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The landing time quantity of a flight, covering ELDT and ALDT values distinguished by prefix.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The take-off time quantity of a flight, covering ETOT, TTOT, CTOT and ATOT values distinguished by prefix.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The start-up approval time quantity of a flight, covering TSAT and ASAT values distinguished by prefix.

classes.name: TaxiTime
classes.definition: An estimated taxi time quantity of a flight, covering EXOT (taxi-out) and EXIT (taxi-in), distinguished by direction.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether this taxi time is Out (EXOT) or In (EXIT).

classes.name: MinimumTurnRoundTime
classes.definition: The minimum/estimated turn-round time (MTTT) used to calculate downstream TOBT and TTOT for a departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The Actual Commence of Ground Handling time (ACGT), specific to flights that are the first operation of the day or have been long-term parked.

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT), the time the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The Actual Ready Time (ARDT), the time all doors are closed and the aircraft is ready to taxi upon TWR instruction.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT), the time start-up is requested.

classes.name: ElapsedTime
classes.definition: The Estimated Elapsed Time given on the ATC Flight Plan, used with ATOT to calculate ELDT.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the sixteen defined events of the Airport CDM process, each with its own trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The number (1-16) identifying the milestone.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the milestone, e.g. 'ATC Flight Plan Activated'.

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The document's definition of the milestone.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone process, as stated in the document.

attributes.name: dataQualityAccuracy
attributes.description: The stated data quality/accuracy for the milestone's information, where given.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to when this milestone occurs.

operations.name: changeOperationalStatus
operations.description: Sets the flight's status to the milestone's resultingStatus, as stated in each milestone's 'Operational Status (changes to)' field.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivatedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: sendFirstEDPI
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data; not sent if information is missing or inconsistent, triggered by first activation of the flight plan (earliest EOBT-3hr) or new/late submissions after cancellation or revised EOBT.

operations.name: checkFlightReadyDeadline
operations.description: Checks that the flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2HourMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr regulated flights receive a CTOT and Network Operations is informed of the updated take-off estimate.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks, before or after take-off from outstation, whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: sendTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations at EOBT-2hrs about the updated take-off time estimate using a T-DPI message.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is manually input it overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: updateELDTFromFUM
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is recorded and used to update landing and take-off estimates.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: A TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take-off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about the updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message, respecting the 5-minute TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT; if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is available it overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: If the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination, ELDT is calculated using the ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdateMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, updating ELDT and commencing the TOBT process.

attributes.name: standGateChangeCutoff
attributes.description: Any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30 minutes, taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT).

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Verifies feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time.

operations.name: checkStandGateChangeAllowed
operations.description: Checks that any change to a stand or gate is not made after ELDT-30 minutes, taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT).

classes.name: FinalApproachMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, updating ELDT and commencing the TOBT process.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Verifies feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: LandedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the actual landing time, triggers an update of downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: updateTOBTAndTTOT
operations.description: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the actual in-block time, triggers an update of downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: updateTOBTAndTTOT
operations.description: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStartedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 8: commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT) triggers an update of downstream estimates, specific to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: updateTOBT
operations.description: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually by the AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: FinalTOBTConfirmationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time at which the AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT.

attributes.name: confirmationOffsetMinutes
attributes.description: TOBT is confirmed t minutes before EOBT, t being a parameter agreed locally.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: Performed at a predefined local-parameter time to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

operations.name: introduceFlightIntoPreDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence once TOBT is confirmed.

classes.name: TSATIssuedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time.

attributes.name: issueOffsetMinutes
attributes.description: TSAT is provided t-minutes before EOBT, t being a locally agreed parameter.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight; no check is performed for this step.

operations.name: sendTDPIs
operations.description: Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, the TOBT input is processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStartsMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is open for passengers to physically start boarding.

attributes.name: checkOffsetMinutes
attributes.description: A local time variable, e.g. corresponding to aircraft type, before TOBT at which the boarding status check is triggered.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain local-variable time before TOBT, checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT, and informs AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReadyMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 12: the time when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi upon TWR instructions (ARDT).

attributes.name: readyTolerance
attributes.description: At TOBT+tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message yet.

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT+tolerance, checks and informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and the Airport CDM Platform has not yet received ARDT or Ready Status (RDY).

classes.name: StartUpRequestedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time that start-up is requested (ASRT), based on pilot request to ATC.

attributes.name: tsatTolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window inside which a start-up request is expected.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start-up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform when it occurs.

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequested
operations.description: If the start-up request is not made by TSAT+tolerance, alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners and informs the AO/GH that no start-up has been requested and TOBT should be updated.

classes.name: StartUpApprovedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the actual time an aircraft receives its start-up approval.

attributes.name: startUpTolerance
attributes.description: In case start-up approval is not granted at TSAT+tolerance, all relevant partners are informed.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start-up approval/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT and alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start-up has been granted at TSAT+tolerance; the flight will be re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the actual time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from the parking position.

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in the case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT.

operations.name: checkTTOTChangeAndNotify
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the actual time the aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take-off.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: An airborne message is generated, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection or ACARS.

operations.name: removeFromDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFSAAndMVT
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated for each flight, processes all available flight information, and performs the ACISP actions defined for each milestone.

operations.name: initiatePlatformForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight and all available information is processed (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateArrivalEstimates
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival (milestone 1 ACISP action).

operations.name: updateDepartureEstimates
operations.description: EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure (milestone 1 ACISP action).

operations.name: commenceDPIProcess
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations, if implemented (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateETOTTTOTCTOT
operations.description: ETOT/TTOT/CTOT updated (milestone 2 ACISP action).

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight that has received a CTOT (milestone 2 ACISP action).

operations.name: updateELDTEIBTTOBTTTOT
operations.description: ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated (ACISP action common to milestones 3, 4 and 5).

operations.name: updateFromALDT
operations.description: ELDT changes to ALDT; EIBT, TOBT and TTOT updated (milestone 6 ACISP action).

operations.name: updateFromAIBT
operations.description: EIBT changes to AIBT; TOBT and TTOT updated (milestone 7 ACISP action).

operations.name: updateFromACGT
operations.description: ETTT/TOBT, TTOT updated (milestone 8 ACISP action).

operations.name: recordTOBTConfirmation
operations.description: Triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before (milestone 9 ACISP action).

operations.name: updateTTOTAfterTSAT
operations.description: TTOT updated (milestone 10 ACISP action).

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: AOBT recorded (milestone 15 ACISP action).

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: ATOT recorded (milestone 16 ACISP action).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC technical system (including radar and A-SMGCS) that detects a flight's position and calculates the Estimated Taxi-Out Time.

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects the flight by radar in FIR, TMA, or on Final Approach, or via A-SMGCS/Radar at take-off (milestones 4, 5, 16).

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft communications addressing and reporting system that reports landing, in-block, off-block and take-off events for equipped aircraft.

operations.name: reportMovementEvent
operations.description: Reports ACARS ON/IN/OUT/OFF events corresponding to ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT (milestones 6, 7, 15, 16).

classes.name: AutomatedDockingSystem
classes.definition: An automated docking system that can provide AIBT and AOBT.

operations.name: detectInBlockOrOffBlock
operations.description: Provides AIBT or AOBT for a flight via automated docking detection (milestones 7, 15).

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The Network Operations system used to monitor a flight's progress and send Flight Update Messages.

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS when within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport (milestone 3).

operations.name: sendFUM
operations.description: Sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress (milestones 2, 3).

classes.name: Message
classes.definition: A message exchanged between stakeholders and systems in the Airport CDM process.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: The party or system that sent the message.

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: The party or system that received the message.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: The time the message was sent.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The content carried by the message.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent to Network Operations, of type E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

attributes.name: dpiType
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message sent, e.g. E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: The SOBT value fed to Network Operations in the first E-DPI (milestone 1).

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration fed to Network Operations in the first E-DPI (milestone 1).

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: First destination data fed to Network Operations in the first E-DPI (milestone 1).

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message (FUM) sent by Network Operations providing updates of a flight's progress.

attributes.name: updatedELDT
attributes.description: The updated ELDT carried by the FUM.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: An MVT message sent at take-off reporting the aircraft's movement.

attributes.name: eventType
attributes.description: The movement event reported, e.g. take-off.

classes.name: FlightStatusAdvisoryMessage
classes.definition: An FSA message sent at take-off advising of the flight's status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The flight status advised by the message.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: A Ready Status (RDY) message indicating the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back.

attributes.name: ready
attributes.description: Whether the aircraft has reported ready status.

classes.name: AirborneMessage
classes.definition: The message generated when the aircraft becomes airborne.

attributes.name: takeOffTime
attributes.description: The ATOT carried by the airborne message.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.
